sourceFile: 66. BRS-161014  Report test improve NG separate VP+CD_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: The draft has citeable rows but invalidly merges distinct report contexts and test factors into one broad comparison.
issues: Two sheet/report contexts are conflated into one review case.
Changed factor mixes LED UV, VP thickness, VP loang, repeated UV passes, and material sorting.
Baseline Normal LED UV applies only to specific LED UV comparisons, not all listed outcomes.
Several outcomes treat header or layout rows as measurement evidence.
Review title and purpose conflict with much of the NG rate evidence.
requiredUserQuestions: Should sheet 25.9 and sheet NG rate be separate review cases?
correctionPlan: Split or clearly scope the two report contexts before final use.
Create separate changed factors for LED UV peak up 10%, VP thickness min/max, and other trials.
Keep Normal LED UV only where rows directly compare against it.
Remove header-only derived measurements and unsupported aggregate stats.
Rebuild outcomes with row-level date, line, type, sample count, and NG-rate grouping preserved.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but grouping citations are insufficient for final evidence.
